question: The then Indonesian President ________ was the first chief guest to grace Republic Day of India in 1950.
solution:
The correct answer is **'__Sukarno__'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** first Republic Day Parade was held on 26 January 1950**, during which the **President of Indonesia Sukarno was the chief gues**t.
 
• Between **1950 and 1954**, Republic Day parades were held at** Irwin Stadium (now National Stadium), Kingsway, Red Fort and Ramlila Maidan.**
 
• **Dr Rajendra Prasad** began his first tenure as President of the Indian Union on this day.
 
• The President addresses the country on the eve of Republic Day.
 
• The republic day celebrations are majorly divided into three parts i.e.** **
 
 
• **the Republic Day Parade. **
 
• **the Beating Retreat. **
 
• **the Award Distributions**.
